description: Enable the azure-pipelines manager, which is off by default, and keep task references pinned to a major version. Adds ci/ to the built-in file patterns, which are additive rather than replaced. Extend this preset after container-config so images declared in a pipeline group with that pipeline

packageRules.description: Azure Pipelines tasks are referenced by major version only. Without this Renovate expands UseDotNet@2 into UseDotNet@2.279.0, which is not valid task syntax and breaks the pipeline
Group non-major Azure Pipelines updates into a single PR
